summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Camera Control Dashboard. All backend APIs and frontend functionality working perfectly. Dashboard displays correct stats (93 sucursales, 547 cámaras), charts render properly, and all interactive features function as expected.

design_issues.impact: Minor - charts render correctly despite warnings

Dashboard loads with correct dark theme
Stats cards display exact expected values (93 sucursales, 547 cámaras, 77 audio, 470 sin audio)
Bar chart renders regions data (CDMX, HIDALGO, QUERETARO, etc.)
Pie chart renders installation types (BALUMS ETHERNET, TRANSCEPTORES, MIXTA)
Data table displays 93 records with pagination (10 per page)
Search functionality works (tested with HIDALGO search)
Table sorting works on column headers
Responsive design and dark theme implementation
